name: Mongolia

fees.name: Tourist visa (K2), single entry - embassy sticker visa
fees.validity: Valid for entry within 90 days of issue; stay per visa (typically 30 days)
fees.applies: all (fee schedule published by Embassy of Mongolia in Washington DC; consular fees vary by mission/reciprocity)
fees.notes: Double entry USD 65; fees payable in USD by money order/cashier's check at the US embassy. Other missions publish local-currency schedules that differ by reciprocity.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa, up to 6 months
fees.applies: all (per Embassy of Mongolia, Washington DC)

fees.name: E-visa - Tourist (K2), single entry, 30-day stay
fees.validity: Valid 150 days from issue; 30-day stay; processed within 72 hours
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (list on evisa.mn); many Western/East Asian nationals are visa-exempt ≤ 30-90 days
fees.notes: Fee is paid online but the official portal only displays the amount at the payment step of an application; no public fee schedule page. Third-party sources cite ~USD 50-53 but this is unverified on an official source, so amount is left null. E-visa also issued for cultural/sports events (K4) and transit (K6).

fees.name: Transit visa (K6), single transit - embassy issued
fees.applies: all (per Embassy of Mongolia, Washington DC)
fees.notes: Double transit USD 50; multiple transit USD 75. Also available as e-visa via evisa.mn.

fees.name: Business visa (B category), single entry
fees.applies: all (embassy fee schedule does not distinguish tourist/business for standard entries)
fees.notes: Same standard fee tier as tourist: single 50 / double 65 / multiple 6mo 105 / multiple 12mo 205 USD.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (border-port visa, Chinggis Khaan Intl Airport and select land ports)
fees.applies: limited cases (usually with prior Immigration Agency approval/invitation)
fees.notes: No official published fee found; third-party reports range ~USD 32-70 (payable in USD or MNT cash). Amount left null pending official confirmation.

reciprocity_variations.note: Per the official VFS Mongolia visa centre (Seoul) fee table (updated Oct 2019), Indian nationals pay no visa fee for tourist/business/transit visas (India-Mongolia reciprocal arrangement).
Chinese nationals applying at the VFS Mongolia centre in Seoul: KRW 116,000 regular (30-day tourist/business); transit KRW 31,000. Reciprocity-based; local-currency equivalents differ by mission.

UK nationals at the Seoul VFS centre: KRW 137,000 regular tourist/business, transit KRW 45,000 - higher reciprocity tier than the default (KRW 57,000). NB: most GBR passport holders are visa-exempt for short tourist stays.
Southeast/South Asian tier (Myanmar, Indonesia, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal, etc.) at Seoul VFS centre: KRW 35,000 tourist/business, KRW 23,000 transit.
USA/CAN nationals are visa-exempt for tourist stays (USA up to 90 days). RUS nationals are visa-exempt up to 30 days under bilateral agreement; no fee applies for those stays.

vfs.note: Mongolia outsources visa intake to VFS Global in at least South Korea (Seoul Mongolia Visa Application Centre). Service fee at the Seoul centre: KRW 5,000 regular, KRW 20,000 express, paid on top of the visa fee. Fees vary by centre.

free_visa_notes: Mongolia is not a Schengen member. Nationals of ~60+ countries (incl. USA up to 90 days, most of EU, UK, JPN, KOR, CAN, AUS under temporary/permanent exemptions, RUS 30 days) enter visa-free for short stays; for them no fee applies. Others use the e-visa (K2/K4/K6) or embassy visas.
